🐶 DOG DASH

Jump spikes as a dog, fly through gaps as a ship, teleport floor-to-ceiling as a spider, flap between pipes as a flappy dog, or pop balloons in balloon mode (every 4 popped = +2 🦴, up to 16 per visit). Gravity Break adds hop-over-spikes frog mode (watch out every 6th spike — it pulls you down) in a scrolling space backdrop. Mix in the Gears adds drone mode (fly to one tiny hidden star for +10 🦴) inside a machine of gears and pipes. Chaos in the Mix throws everything together and only runs on Insanity difficulty. Obstacles get tighter the further you go.
